seo.title: Portland Homeless Help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified practical resources for people experiencing homelessness in Portland.

page.heading: PORTLAND - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: 911. Shelter and local resource referrals: 211. Crisis support: call or text 988.
page.notice: Availability, eligibility, hours, and capacity can change. Call ahead when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, job, or legal representation.
page.intro: Call 211 or use the Multnomah County shelter list for current openings. Services and capacity can change quickly.
page.footer: Information can change. Call ahead when possible and report incorrect information through the GitHub link in the footer.

entries.title: Emergency services — 911
entries.description: For immediate danger, fire, a life-threatening medical emergency, or violence.
entries.how_to_access: Give the exact location and explain what is happening.

entries.title: Oregon 2-1-1
entries.description: Free referrals for shelter, food, health, benefits, and other services.
entries.how_to_access: Dial 211 and explain your current needs.

entries.title: Multnomah County emergency shelter list
entries.description: Official list of emergency shelters and access instructions. Openings, eligibility, and intake methods vary.
entries.how_to_access: Check the current list or call 211 before traveling.

entries.title: Portland Rescue Mission — Burnside Shelter
entries.description: Faith-based emergency services for adults that can include meals, overnight shelter, restrooms, showers, clothing, and mail. Capacity varies.
entries.how_to_access: Call or check current intake times; ask whether religious activities are optional.

entries.title: Portland Rescue Mission — meals
entries.description: Free meals and basic services; schedules can change.
entries.how_to_access: Check current meal times before traveling.

entries.title: CityTeam Portland — meals and shelter services
entries.description: Faith-based meals and basic services. Programs and eligible groups vary.
entries.how_to_access: Call to confirm the current meal schedule.

entries.title: CityTeam Portland — showers
entries.description: Shower access is offered on limited schedules; times and eligible groups can change.
entries.how_to_access: Call before traveling and ask about the current shower schedule.

entries.title: Central City Concern — Old Town Clinic
entries.description: Primary and behavioral health care for adults, with experience serving people experiencing homelessness.
entries.how_to_access: Call for current appointment and walk-in information.

entries.title: Multnomah County Find Help
entries.description: Official directory for day services, hygiene, shelter, food, and related help.
entries.how_to_access: Use the directory or call 211 to confirm current access.

entries.title: ONE Oregon benefits portal
entries.description: Apply for food, medical, cash, and child-care benefits.
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or ask a service provider for help; approval depends on eligibility.

entries.title: WorkSource Portland Metro
entries.description: Free job-search assistance, training information, workshops, and employer connections.
entries.how_to_access: Find a local center and confirm hours.

entries.title: Oregon Law Center
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income people; case acceptance depends on issue and capacity.

entries.title: Portland Rescue Mission — mail service
entries.description: Mail service may be available to registered guests; rules and capacity can change.
entries.how_to_access: Ask staff about registration and current mail rules.

entries.title: Call to Safety
entries.description: Confidential domestic and sexual violence crisis support and local referrals.
entries.how_to_access: Call when safe; call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
entries.description: Connects veterans who are homeless or at risk with VA services and local resources.
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain that you are a veteran who is homeless or at risk.

entries.title: Portland Animal Welfare Team
entries.description: Veterinary and pet-support services for people experiencing homelessness or extreme poverty. Clinics and eligibility vary.
entries.how_to_access: Check current clinic and appointment instructions.
